result:
All questions answered. Here are the findings:

1. **h01** — S3 presign background runner (`s3presign.Runner`) — refreshes presigned URLs for S3-stored attachments every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`: constructed and run once at server/server.go:162-163, then looped via `Run` in a goroutine at server/server.go:166-170 (invoked from `Start` at server/server.go:129).

2. **h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (async path enqueues via `PostAsync` webhook.go:184 into `asyncPostQueue`, drained by 4 workers calling `Post`, webhook.go:42-54). Protection: SSRF guard — `safeDialContext` on the shared HTTP client blocks dials resolving to reserved/private IPs (internal/webhook/webhook.go:29-77) using `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` in internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54, plus create-time `ValidateURL` (validate.go:63).

3. **h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, internal/idp/idp.go:1-8); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth 2.0, `NewIdentityProvider` at internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:27, used in server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:121).

4. **h04** — No. `mysql.NewDB` is called only inside the factory `NewDBDriver` (store/db/db.go:22). A repo-wide grep for `NewDB` shows the only other callers are `db.NewDBDriver` itself in store/test/store.go:28,50 (which goes through the factory); the other `NewDB` hits are the sqlite/postgres/mysql declarations themselves (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20).

5. **h05** — Explicit Go code, inside the driver's transactional `DeleteUser`: `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:400-403, called at :102) and `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` for reactions on the user's memos (:380-388, called at :96); identical code in mysql/user_delete.go:96,102 and postgres/user_delete.go:96,102. Not a database rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign key at all (store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99).

6. **h06** — Handlers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157), `UpdateMemo` (memo_service.go:513 → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:562), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:119), `SetMemoRelations` (memo_relation_service.go:48), `SetMemoAttachments` (memo_attachment_service.go:48). All paths converge on `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (via `webhook.PostAsync` → worker queue → `Post`).

7. **h07** — Route registration `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` → `serveUserAvatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
   `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
   `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
   `Store.GetUser` (cache check, then `Store.ListUsers`) — store/user.go:148, 136
   `(*DB).ListUsers` (driver, sqlite default) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88

8. **h08** — `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43) — invoked — server/server.go:163 and s3presign/runner.go:36. `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27) — not invoked from production code (only the package-level function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from memo_service.go:108,447; `memopayload.NewRunner` has no production caller).

9. **h09** — 6 declarations: `SSEHub.Close` (server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99), `Store.Close` (store/store.go:72), `cache.Cache.Close` (store/cache/cache.go:187), and `DB.Close` in sqlite (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67), postgres (store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46), mysql (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47). Invoked from non-test server code: `Store.Close` — server/server.go:146; `SSEHub.Close` — server/server.go:206; `Cache.Close` — store/store.go:74-76; the three driver `DB.Close` — via `s.driver.Close()` at store/store.go:78 (interface dispatch; which one runs depends on driver).

10. **h10** — `util.GenUUID` — internal/util/util.go:40 — highest fan-in: ~28 call sites repo-wide (~7 in non-test code, e.g. server/auth/token.go, attachment_service_storage.go, auth_service_session.go, shortcut_service.go). Next-closest internal/ symbols (`filter.DefaultEngine`, `base.UIDMatcher`) have ≤8.

11. **h11** — 1st: `store.User` — referenced from ~6 packages outside store/ (server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/api/v1/test, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss). 2nd: `store.Memo` — ~4 packages (server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload).

12. **h12** — `(*DB).CreateMemo` in store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16 (INSERT built at memo.go:41). Determination: the default driver is `"sqlite"` (`viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` cmd/memos/main.go:122 and flag default at :130); the factory `NewDBDriver` selects `sqlite.NewDB` for that value (store/db/db.go:20); `Store.CreateMemo` delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo` (store/memo.go:113), so the interface call dispatches to the sqlite implementation.

13. **h13** — Impl: unexported `markdown.service` (goldmark-backed, internal/markdown/markdown.go:59), the sole implementation of interface `markdown.Service` (markdown.go:31). Constructed by `markdown.NewService` (markdown.go:85), called in production from `NewAPIV1Service` (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48). Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (v1.go:35), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (server/router/rss/rss.go:45, injected at server/server.go:85), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16).

14. **h14** — Computed in `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88), which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (memo_service.go:447), and the bulk rebuild `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (runner.go:27). Extracted: `Payload.Tags` (#tags) and `Payload.Property` — leading-H1 `Title`, `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:193-228, 365-387).

15. **h15** — gRPC API read check: `checkMemoReadAccess` (used by GetMemo etc.) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67
    gRPC API list filtering: `ListMemos` visibility list/filter — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227 (same pattern in user_service_stats.go:84-90)
    File server: `checkAttachmentPermission` (memo visibility + share-token check for attachments) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-705
    RSS feeds: public-only `VisibilityList` — server/router/rss/rss.go:90, 141
    Frontend sitemap: public-only memos — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:149-151

16. **r01** — False premise: there is no Redis anywhere (no redis import/config in any Go file). The cache layer is an in-process, in-memory cache (`store/cache/cache.go`); user entries live in `Store.userCache` created with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute` (store/store.go:40-52).

17. **r02** — False premise: no per-user API rate-limiting middleware exists. The only echo middleware registered is `Recover` and CORS (server/server.go:50-51); grep for rate-limit code finds nothing.

18. **r03** — False premise: there is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. `internal/scheduler` exists but is imported by no package outside itself (only its own tests/examples); no cleanup job is scheduled anywhere.

19. **r04** — False premise: neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used (no such imports exist). Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue` (capacity 128) drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-54, enqueued via `PostAsync` (webhook.go:184).

20. **r05** — False premise: there is no GraphQL schema. The public API is gRPC with protobuf definitions under proto/api/v1, exposed over HTTP via gRPC-Gateway (`apiV1Service.RegisterGateway`, server/server.go:88, service in server/router/api/v1/v1.go), plus non-GraphQL surfaces: RSS (server/router/rss), file server (server/router/fileserver), and MCP (server/router/mcp).
